evidence.title: Sora UI – Animated React Components for shadcn/ui

name: Sora UI
summary: Copy-paste animated React components for shadcn/ui, built with Motion, GSAP and Tailwind CSS.
description: A registry of animated React components — motion primitives, buttons, dialogs, loaders, text effects and scroll reveals, plus animated Lucide icons — built with Motion and GSAP on Tailwind CSS v4 and distributed as shadcn-compatible code. Install via shadcn CLI commands or the standalone sora-cli, with MCP support and full TypeScript source. Free forever: every primitive is available with no paywall, and commercial use is allowed.
contains: 133 registry items installable with the shadcn CLI or sora-cli
motion primitives, Base UI and Radix UI components, animated Lucide icons
animated with Motion and GSAP, with reduced-motion support
free forever — no Pro plan, commercial use allowed
original code MIT; parts derived from Animate UI keep its Commons Clause restriction
